summary: Detects no input for a period and fires, so an attract loop can take over.
overview: Watches for mouse, touch and keyboard input and fires when none has happened for long enough — wire that to an attract video, a slideshow or a return to the home screen. Any input resets it and ends idle exactly once per idle period, not on every input frame.
useCases: An attract loop on a kiosk between visitors.
Returning to the home screen after someone walks away.
Dimming or sleeping a display after inactivity.

params.tuning: Long enough that reading a screen does not trigger it. Thirty seconds is short for anything with text on it.

gotchas.title: It polls the legacy Input class
gotchas.body: Matching this project's LegacyInputManager default. On a project using the Input System package, the detection block is the part to swap.

gotchas.title: It watches the whole application, not one flow
gotchas.body: For "are you still there" inside a single form or checkout, SessionTimeoutManager is the scoped version.
